Target Pests
  • All species of lawn ants, carpenter ants, fire ants, billbugs, fleas, mites, scorpions, and ticks
  • See label for the complete list
Active Ingredient(s) Bifenthrin 7.9%
Use Sites

Quali-Pro Bifenthrin I/T 7.9 F controls a wide range of listed pests. It works on flowers, foliage plants, shrubs, ornamental trees, and non-bearing fruit and nut trees. It can be used inside and outside, in places like hotels, office buildings, and shopping malls, and around sports fields, homes, schools, parks, and recreation areas. Non-bearing fruit and nut trees are those that will not produce a harvestable crop during the season of application.
Mixture

Indoor structures and buildings and modes of transportation uses:  Use 0.33 to 1 oz. of Bifenthrin I/T 7.9F per gallon of water.  

Lawn applications: Use 1 oz. of gallon of water per 1,000 sq. ft.
Application

Follow these steps for effective tank mixing:

  • Add wettable powders to the tank water and mix thoroughly.
  • Next, add liquids and flowables, then mix again.
  • Add emulsifiable concentrates last, ensuring a thorough mix.
